title: Adjoint local model maps embed into a product under joint zero detection
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $(\mathcal B_i)_{i\in I}$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with $I$ a set. For each $i$ let $F_i:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B_i$ be an additive functor preserving kernels, and let $G_i:\mathcal B_i\to\mathcal A$ be a right adjoint, with adjunction unit $\eta_i:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal A}\to G_iF_i$. Here $F_i\dashv G_i$ means specified natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B_i}(F_iM,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,G_iB)$, with their unit and counit. Suppose the $F_i$ jointly detect zero objects: if $F_iN$ is zero for every $i$, then $N$ is zero. Fix $M\in\mathcal A$, objects $B_i\in\mathcal B_i$, and isomorphisms $e_i:F_iM\xrightarrow{\sim}B_i$. If the product $P=\prod_{i\in I}G_iB_i$ exists [def-weil-category-product], the map $u:M\to P$ whose $i$-th component is $G_i(e_i)\circ\eta_{i,M}$ is a monomorphism. In particular this applies to $B_i=F_iM$ and $e_i=\mathrm{id}$.
